title: Bài sonnet dang dở
about: Round 41, thu-vien ("tôi thấy không hay, bạn hãy sáng tác theo ý của bạn và dùng bộ sound phù hợp"), Nocturnes for an Old Library, An Unfinished Sonnet: a sonnet left unfinished on the desk, F minor at 52 bpm: a question left hanging on C, an answer that turns aside to Db instead of home, then at last an answer that closes; the chord broken slowly upward in quarters (texture slowarp); the middle in Ab major. The piano alone, on thu-vien (ke-chuyen-gan's grand, hall and echo, with nothing heavy: no Rhodes, the lows not lifted, the left hand from C3 with no octave); a singing line in periods, a question and an answer, each return varied; soft, a gentle swell in the middle, no climax. An original tune.
